title: PyTorch Introduction — Let Operations Record the Gradient Trail
key_insight: Autograd records operations involving tensors that require gradients. Calling `backward()` follows that graph in reverse and fills each parameter’s gradient field.
body:
## Let Operations Record the Gradient Trail

Writing every derivative by hand would make even a small network fragile. The framework already saw each operation during the forward pass.

Autograd records operations involving tensors that require gradients. Calling `backward()` follows that graph in reverse and fills each parameter’s gradient field.

Gradients accumulate by default. Clear them deliberately, and use `no_grad` or inference mode when no backward pass will follow.
common_mistakes: A tensor can contain only one number.
An nn.Module prevents parameters from being trained.
Autograd requires every derivative to be entered by hand.
